correctness.rationale: The leading commutator lemma forces parity of the first nonzero term of a formal composition square. Direct expansion yields one independent triangular equation with invertible leading coefficient for every even exponent. Its exact count gives all finite-jet depth strata; modifying coefficient of degree j cannot affect the square below degree j+d, proving the N+d liftability criterion and its sufficient formal completion recursion. Exact geometric sums give both closed totals. Standalone direct-composition checker exhaustively verifies 21 field/truncation configurations (orders 2, 4, 8) and replay matched the embedded record; the proof covers all N and q independently. Boundary N=3 and all nonidentity depths 1..N-2 are included.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves two naturally distinct invariants of the finite approximation tower of a profinite group: all order-two elements and the image of genuine order-two elements. Complete all-level depth distributions, an explicit necessary-and-sufficient lifting test, and the asymptotic 1/N liftable fraction quantify a structural obstruction not visible in ordinary torsion conjugacy classifications. The motivating problem is not an arbitrary isolated computation or a routine preexisting table.
